text: A股零售板块午后再度拉升，百大集团涨停，国芳集团、汇嘉时代此前封板，国光连锁、新华百货、东百集团涨幅居前。
text_en: A-share retail sector rallied again in the afternoon, with Baida Group hitting the limit up, Guofang Group and Huijia Times previously hitting the limit up, and Guoguang Chain, Xinhua Department Store and Dongbai Group among the top gainers.
